web.title: 我用脚本给几百个微信好友群发了祝福 - A Cat Entertainer
web.description:
# 我用脚本给几百个微信好友群发了祝福
## 基础方案：AppleScript
```applescript
tell application "WeChat"
    activate
    delay 0.5
    tell application "System Events"
        keystroke "f" using command down  -- Command+F 搜索
        delay 0.3
        keystroke "对方微信名"
        delay 0.5
        keystroke return
        delay 0.3
        keystroke "新年快乐！"
        delay 0.2
        keystroke return
    end tell
end tell
```

## 批量发送的问题
```python
import subprocess
import time

contacts = ["张三", "李四", "王五"]  # 从文件读取
message = "新年快乐！🎉"

for name in contacts:
    script = f'''
    tell application "WeChat" to activate
    delay 0.5
    tell application "System Events"
        keystroke "f" using command down
        delay 0.3
        keystroke "{name}"
        delay 0.5
        keystroke return
        delay 0.3
        keystroke "{message}"
        delay 0.2
        keystroke return
    end tell
    '''
    subprocess.run(["osascript", "-e", script])
    time.sleep(3)  # 风控间隔
```
